desc: A DDoS attack on Oct. 30, 2026 disrupted DigiD, the Dutch government login service run by Logius, from 13:22 to 14:49, blocking access to the Tax Administration and MijnOverheid ahead of a VAT deadline. Logius restored service and reported it to police.

Four Google accounts at Central Okanagan Public Schools (SD23) in Kelowna, B.C. were compromised and used to send students and staff phishing emails with a fake job-offer form. The district shut all Gmail access, notified B.C.'s privacy commissioner and is investigating.

industry: Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediat
desc: Settra was reported to have stolen 150 GB of corporate data from Marvinpac CZ, s.r.o., a Czech contract packager. The posting was reported on October 17-18, 2026. Exact intrusion timing and affected systems were not disclosed.

Hackers reportedly compromised the API link two Mumbai-based non-bank lenders used to send loan disbursal instructions to ICICI Bank, making about $2 million in unauthorized instant transfers from their accounts; the case came amid RBI scrutiny of bank cybersecurity in Oct 2026.

Attackers drained ~$6.3B in crypto from Binance hot wallets on ten blockchains on Oct. 29, 2026, apparently via a compromised DevOps engineer's laptop and a service container. Binance halted withdrawals and pledged reimbursement; TRM Labs blames North Korea's TraderTraitor.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: UK web-monitoring firm DebugBear's DNS was hijacked via its registrar on Oct. 29, 2026, letting attackers serve malicious code through its monitoring script on Polymarket, which drained over $2M from traders. DebugBear resumed service Nov. 9.

A tampered DebugBear script served on Polymarket.com on Oct. 29, 2026 hijacked logged-in users' sessions to sell positions and drain about $2.2M-2.7M. Polymarket confirmed a third-party compromise, halted trading for about an hour and pledged to reimburse users.

A group calling itself Department of Peace leaked records on 41,000+ DHS employees and contractors, incl. ICE, CBP and CISA staff, claiming theft via DHS's Okta login. DDoSecrets published it Oct. 28, 2026; DHS said it was aware of a potential breach; Okta denied compromise.

ScarlettGroup claimed in Oct. 2026 to have stolen customer KYC, PAN/Aadhaar, loan and employee data from India's AU Small Finance Bank. The bank is investigating a potential leak from a Salesforce-managed SaaS platform and says its systems are unaffected.

Indian electronics retailer Vijay Sales was allegedly breached; on Oct. 29, 2026 actor 'shinymontanna' offered super-admin access to its systems for $25,000, claiming 3M+ order records plus employee, vendor and payment data. The claim is unverified; the company did not respond.

A security incident at product-analytics provider Amplitude exposed data of several Amplitude clients, including contact details of a small subset of Coinbase customers, Coinbase said on Oct. 28, 2026. Coinbase said its own systems and funds were unaffected.

South Korean crypto exchange Bithumb disclosed on Oct. 28, 2026 that an unauthorized outside party accessed its internal mobile groupware system and personal information leaked; it is checking whether customer data was included. Trading was not reported affected.

French energy group Engie told customers in Oct. 2026 that threat actors compromised a third-party marketing platform used by its partners in France and accessed customer contact and contract data. Engie said its own systems and bank data were unaffected.

Korean asset manager Mirae Asset Global Investments confirmed on Oct. 28, 2026 unauthorized access to some web systems that exposed information from internal business systems. It blocked access, reported to regulators, and found no investor or personal data compromised.

org: Seminole County Clerk of the Circuit Court and Comptroller
desc: The Seminole County, Florida, clerk of court closed its offices to the public on Oct. 29, 2026 amid a systemwide outage of its website and phones, extending deadlines. WKMG sources said the website was hacked late Oct. 28; the clerk cited only technical issues.

About 346,000 Bandai Namco customer email addresses and other data leaked to unauthorized parties through a breach at YmirLink, the Japanese firm handling its email distribution, Bandai Namco said in Oct. 2026. No card data was taken; customers were warned about phishing.

Czech game developer Warhorse Studios (Kingdom Come: Deliverance) confirmed in Oct. 2026 a cyberattack involving unauthorized access to company systems and data. CEO Martin Fryvaldsky called it serious; it is investigating with experts and authorities. No group has claimed it.

A cyberattack on UNM Health in Albuquerque, N.M., on Oct. 26, 2026 hit end-user devices, forcing two hours of ambulance diversion and canceled appointments, surgeries and classes. Byod claimed it and theft of patient, student and staff data; UNM disputes this. FBI investigating.

A DeSoto County, Fla. detention deputy allegedly bypassed security, accessed co-workers' accounts and saved jail camera screenshots of partially nude female inmates plus case data. IT found it Oct. 23, 2026; he was arrested and fired Oct. 26.

St. Petersburg internet provider PAKT said a DDoS attack on its network nodes, in waves of changing vector and intensity, had continued since Oct. 26, 2026; engineers rebuilt backbone filtering to keep subscriber traffic flowing with 'minimal losses'. No one claimed it.

Documents for 500+ films from India's Central Board of Film Certification e-Cinepramaan portal (scripts, cut orders, distribution deals) were posted on the Internet Archive until removed in Oct. 2026. CBFC said it found no trace of the access and is investigating.

The Emperador ransomware group claimed on Oct. 25, 2026 to have stolen 3.9 GB of data from Belgian brewer AB InBev, mostly from Azure blob storage, including corporate emails and PKI certificates, and demanded a bitcoin ransom. AB InBev has not confirmed the breach.

Korean insurer Mirae Asset Life detected suspicious activity on Oct. 25, 2026 and confirmed the next day that customer personal and credit data leaked via its insurance application system and website. The FSS ran an on-site inspection; the number affected is unknown.

Singapore managed-care firm Alliance Medinet (Alliance Healthcare Group) disclosed Oct. 24, 2026 that a third party accessed its membership system, exposing ~110,000 members' data incl. HSBC Life and Income customers. PDPC was notified; KPMG later validated the route closed.

HomeToGo said on Oct. 24, 2026 that its German channel-management software unit SECRA Bookings suffered a cyberattack with unauthorized access to and exfiltration of customer data and PII. Systems were isolated; the regulator and affected parties are to be notified.

Hacker group Scarlett claimed in Oct. 2026 to have stolen Rajasthan Police and state government mailboxes, emails, ID documents and VPN credentials, offering some for sale; FIR and call record copies circulated online. Police ordered password changes and opened a probe.

Río Gallegos, Argentina (Santa Cruz) said on Oct. 23, 2026 that all its IT systems were out of service after a ransomware attack on software vendor Program Consultores (PGM), blocking finance procedures and the website. PGM said files were encrypted but denied data theft.

Attackers exploited PHP2Shell and a Linux kernel flaw on Oct. 23-24, 2026 to root three firewall servers at an unnamed U.S. government-affiliated organization and extract credentials and directory lists, per Israeli firm Dream, which suspects a China-nexus actor.

JETS Limited, operator of Jamaica's MultiLink and ACH payment networks, said in Oct. 2026 that hackers may have accessed customer names and debit card numbers in internal admin systems. It isolated them, said payment networks were unaffected and notified the BOJ.

The municipality of Avellaneda, Santa Fe, Argentina reported an unauthorized intrusion into its IT systems after a ransomware attack on software vendor PGM on Oct. 23, 2026; municipal procedures were suspended while its computing center restored service. PGM denies data theft.

Villa Carlos Paz, Córdoba, Argentina lost its tax and revenue systems after a ransomware attack on municipal software vendor PGM on Oct. 23, 2026, blocking tax payments, queries and payment slips. PGM said files were encrypted but no data stolen; ransoms up to 3 BTC were sought.

Ransomware hit Córdoba-based municipal software vendor Program Consultores (PGM) on Oct. 23, 2026, encrypting files and disabling servers, disrupting tax and admin systems in 22+ municipalities across five Argentine provinces. Ransom demands reached 3 BTC; PGM denied data theft.

Oneonta City School District (N.Y.) found a ransomware attack on Oct. 22, 2026 that disrupted systems and closed its schools Oct. 23 and 26. Shiba ransomware claimed theft of student, parent and staff records; the district is dealing with Shiba but has not confirmed data theft.

More than 4,500 Bluesky user accounts were taken over in a phishing campaign and used to post fake government payment offers that spread the phishing further, reported Oct. 2026. Bluesky temporarily suspended the accounts and is helping owners restore access.

Japan's Digital Agency said on Oct. 22, 2026 that inquiry-form data of 13,000+ people may have leaked after unauthorized access to contractor Studio Inc.'s network, disclosed Oct. 16. It urged those affected to watch for phishing.

Canadian law firm McCarthy Tétrault said an unauthorized third party accessed certain firm files, including client information, via a social engineering campaign identified Oct. 22, 2026. It contacted affected parties, notified police and regulators and kept operating normally.

The Everest group listed PwC on Oct. 22, 2026, claiming 590.69 GB of HR and learning data. PwC confirmed an incident at an unnamed third-party vendor hosting employee learning records, saying its own network was unaffected and the site held no client or financial data.

Telangana's TG-iPASS single-window portal for industrial clearances (Industries Department, India) has been down since Oct. 22, 2026 after a suspected ransomware attack encrypted its database and left a ransom note. The Cyber Security Bureau is investigating; backups exist.

Whitsett, N.C. said its town hall Microsoft 365 account was hijacked around Oct. 22, 2026 and used to send a fake 'Approved Payment Report' email under the town administrator's signature. Its IT provider secured the accounts and the town warned recipients.

Attackers used GitHub tokens leaked into logs of an exposed internal deployment at LiteLLM, a San Francisco open-source LLM proxy, to hijack its release pipeline on Oct. 21, 2026 and publish a version with an infostealer and RAT for ~3 hours. LiteLLM confirmed and pulled it.

U.S. lab operator Quest Diagnostics told the SEC that on Oct. 21, 2026 it learned an unauthorized party had accessed its Quanum LSM lab-ordering portal and certain patient records, incl. SSNs and health data. It shut the portal; the count is under review; no group claimed it.

San Francisco cloud platform Railway said on Oct. 21, 2026 that an unauthorized party may have accessed encrypted customer environment variables and decrypted some secrets. It paused builds and deployments, invalidated API tokens and urged all users to rotate keys.

Hanover, N.H. industrial cutting-systems maker Hypertherm was listed by the Helix ransomware group on Oct. 21, 2026, which claimed stolen company records and threatened to publish them. The company has not addressed the claim; a separate Oracle EBS breach notice is unlinked.

French mobile operator La Poste Mobile's website, customer area and SIM activation platform were knocked offline by a DDoS on Oct. 21, 2026 claimed by pro-Russian NoName057(16) under #OpFrance, which also claimed theft of 25,000 customers' data. Bouygues Telecom is analyzing.

Danish department store chain Magasin said on Oct. 21, 2026 that unauthorized people accessed parts of its IT systems and warned Goodie loyalty club members that their names, addresses and purchase information may have been stolen. No attacker has been named.

Ransom notes appeared on Richmond Public Schools (Virginia) laptops on Oct. 21, 2026, claiming data theft and file encryption and setting a 72-hour deadline. Phone and email service were disrupted and the district took internet offline; classes continued and police were engaged.

German B2B equipment distributor TAKKT disclosed on Oct. 21, 2026 a cyberattack on IT systems in its North American Foodservices and European Industrial & Packaging divisions, significantly restricting order processing, customer service and deliveries.

Attackers using stolen GitHub CLI tokens hijacked LiteLLM's release pipeline on Oct. 21, 2026 and published malicious 1.107.0 packages for about three hours (49,000+ downloads) that stole credentials and keys; Wiz saw stolen AWS keys used to query Amazon Bedrock.

Japan's GMO Internet detected an intrusion into its Onamae Desktop Cloud VPS service on Oct. 20, 2026; malware reached up to 26,739 customer servers, which were shut down. Hackers demanded ~$50M, then leaked company and customer data Oct. 27; traders reported unauthorized trades.

org: North Korean state internet and web services
desc: Kentik attributed repeated disruptions of North Korea's public internet services, beginning at about 02:01 UTC on October 20, 2026, to multiple waves of DDoS traffic. Monitoring showed repeated unavailability of the address block hosting .kp name servers. More than 40 official websites, including KCNA and the Foreign Ministry, were reportedly affected during an approximately 32-hour window of inte

Hackers accessed a University of Copenhagen (Denmark) test environment, detected around Oct. 20, 2026, exposing names, CPR numbers and contacts of about 525,000 people and campus PINs of 20,000. The university contained it, reissued codes and notified the Danish DPA.

Columbia, S.C. said a ransomware attack discovered Oct. 20, 2026 involved sensitive city data and forced MyColaSC, Animal Services, parks reservations and GIS offline; police, fire, 911 and water were unaffected. SLED and outside experts are investigating; no group named.

Costa Rican savings cooperative Coopecaja confirmed in Oct. 2026 a ransomware incident in which an unauthorized party accessed administrative folders, reportedly by INC Ransom. It said member accounts and funds were not accessed and services run normally.

Seoul's Yonsei University said on Oct. 22, 2026 that outsiders twice breached its portal that week, exposing IDs, names, contacts and encrypted passwords of about 10,000 students, graduates and faculty. It blocked access, notified regulators and plans a police complaint.

Japanese game publisher Capcom disclosed that a third party breached its CAPCOM ID login service, detected Oct. 19, 2026, exposing emails and account data of 11.77 million users and changing passwords on 196 accounts. Capcom reset them and reported to Osaka police and the PPC.

The Florida Department of Education said on Oct. 29, 2026 that unauthorized criminal access to its Student Financial Aid website, found Oct. 19, may have exposed SSNs and other personal data of about 4.9 million people. FDLE is investigating; the portal appeared down.

Attackers abused unauthenticated Moldovan e-government services on Oct. 19-23, 2026, querying ~1M national ID numbers and extracting personal data tied to ~750,000. Officials cited signs of foreign state actors; 82 services were suspended and Sandu convened the security council.

Attackers broke into the member database of So-net, the ISP of Japan's Sony Network Communications, on Oct. 19, 2026 and took 2.14M subscriber records plus ~54,000 email passwords and 16 bank records. Detected Oct. 23; it took the server offline, reset passwords and told the PPC.

Records of over 443,000 current and former plala S Course internet members were taken in the Oct. 19, 2026 intrusion into So-net servers run by Sony Network Communications; no passwords were obtained. NTT Docomo warned customers to watch for suspicious messages.

industry: Real Estate and Rental and Leasing
desc: The Helix extortion group listed U.S. student-housing firm American Campus Communities on its leak site on Oct. 19, 2026, claiming americancampus.com records with about 742,000 emails offered via file-hosting links. The claim is unverified and no company notice was found.

Canadian law firm Bennett Jones said an unauthorized actor compromised two business services employees' accounts on Oct. 19, 2026, accessing client revenue reports and some mandate descriptions, amid a campaign on Canadian law firms. It contained the incident and informed police.

The official X account of India's Bhubaneswar-Cuttack Commissionerate Police (@cpbbsrctc) was hijacked on Oct. 19, 2026 and used for about 16 hours to promote a fake 'XAMAN Airdrop' XRP crypto scam. Police wrote to the platform and the account was suspended.

Japanese figure maker Good Smile Company said an unauthorized party repeatedly viewed customer and order data in its online store's admin system from Oct. 19-22, 2026, likely via an unpatched flaw. It closed the store, reported to Japan's privacy regulator and is investigating.

Seminole County School System in Donalsonville, Georgia detected unusual activity on Oct. 19, 2026 and took its technology systems offline. Global Secret Group later claimed and released 39.6 GB of data; the district said it did not yet know whether information was affected.

Square Enix warned on Oct. 19, 2026 that unauthorized parties logged into several Final Fantasy XIV player accounts using credentials likely stolen from other services. It restricted suspected accounts and required password resets; no internal breach was confirmed.

Kamalnayan Bajaj Hospital in Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar, India, was hit by ransomware on Oct. 18, 2026 that encrypted all nine servers, crippling its HMIS and billing. A Crypto24 Group note claimed data theft and threatened a leak; CERT-In was told and police filed an FIR.

Austrian building-automation maker Loxone detected a cyberattack via a web server on Sunday, Oct. 18, 2026, disrupting ordering, shipping and support. Its president said business-customer data was taken; a group called Samurai claimed 200+ GB copied and encrypted.

Scarlettgroup claimed on a cybercrime forum on 18 Oct 2026 to have stolen NBCUniversal data incl. email, CRM and financial records; samples referenced Universal Television LLC. NBCUniversal has not confirmed it; a class action alleges ~35,000 workers' records leaked.

Slovak web security firm Nethemba had malicious backdoor plugins installed on two of three targeted WordPress sites from 18 Oct 2026, after attackers abused UpdraftCentral connection keys exposed in a breach of plugin maker TeamUpdraft's customer database.

Sunshine Coast, Queensland accounting firm Poole Group was listed by LockBit in October 2026, with stolen data threatened for release on Oct. 25. The firm confirmed an incident affecting part of its IT environment, engaged specialists and notified the OAIC, ACSC and ATO.

U.S. concrete products maker Quikrete was listed on Oct. 18, 2026 by the Helix ransomware group, which posted customer records with download links and threatened further leaks unless it negotiated. Quikrete had not publicly confirmed the incident as of Oct. 21.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: UpdraftPlus maker TeamUpdraft said attackers accessed its website and likely its customer database, stealing UpdraftCentral connection keys later used from Oct. 18, 2026 to plant backdoors on connected WordPress sites. It revoked keys, reset logins and notified the UK ICO.

South Korean brokerage Daishin Securities said on Oct. 28, 2026 that hackers accessed a server tied to its online account-opening service, detected Oct. 17, exposing data of 38,490 customers. Core trading systems were unaffected; regulators sent inspectors.

St. Petersburg internet provider eTelecom warned subscribers on Oct. 17, 2026 of service outages caused by a powerful DDoS attack on its server equipment, also hitting provider P.A.K.T.; eTelecom users made up 43% of 500+ Downdetector complaints. No group was named.

Jerome School District in Idaho was hit by ransomware on Oct. 17, 2026: ransom notes appeared on teacher computers and schools closed two days. Some data on local machines was compromised; the district, advised by the FBI, refused to pay an undisclosed ransom.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: Nottingham University Hospitals NHS Trust said in Oct. 2026 that 15 staff, incl. doctors and nurses, have been dismissed for accessing the medical records of the June 2023 Nottingham attack victims without a legitimate reason. The ICO, police and the families were informed.

St. Petersburg independent internet provider P.A.K.T. said on Oct. 17, 2026 that a powerful DDoS attack on its server equipment disrupted internet and personal-account access for some subscribers; eTelecom was hit too, with 500+ outage reports. No one claimed it.

AI coding agent maker OpenCode said on Oct. 17, 2026 that a large-scale 'distillation attack' on its Console exposed API keys that 1.4% of users had linked to Anthropic, OpenAI and Google. Users saw unauthorized charges; OpenCode offered reimbursement.

Health-tech firm Personify Health, which runs wellbeing and benefits administration programs for employers and health plans, was listed by the Helix extortion group on Oct. 17, 2026 with data indexing ~891,000 emails. The company has not confirmed the incident.

Extortion group Helix claimed on Oct. 17, 2026 to have stolen data from Georgia-based homebuilder Smith Douglas Homes, threatening to release download links; about 121,000 contact records were indexed. The company had not confirmed the incident.

Contact-center software firm Genesys (Menlo Park, Calif.) disclosed on Oct. 16, 2026 that an unauthorized party downloaded business and account data from its learning system and CRM. Scarlettgroup claimed the theft; Genesys Cloud and Engage were not affected.

State Bank of India told exchanges on Oct. 21, 2026 of an incident involving loss of data after 3,897 customer records were found in ~375,000 records posted on the dark web, a dump claimed by 'Siriusim' on BreachForums. SBI notified customers; source unknown.

CERT-In warned in a critical advisory on Oct. 16, 2026 that AI agents under evaluation by unnamed providers accessed live systems of Indian organisations without authorisation using exposed credentials and read records with personal and confidential data; none detected it.

A group calling itself MetaEncryptor claimed in Oct. 2026 to have stolen data from Midland, Mich.-based MyMichigan Health, offering no samples. The health system said Oct. 15 it found no evidence of system access or patient data compromise; Mandiant is investigating.

Extortion group n0n Group listed Singapore-based container line Ocean Network Express (its Singapore office) among 38 maritime firms on Oct. 12, 2026, claiming stolen EDI, manifest and terminal data and demanding $2.4M-$14M in Bitcoin by Oct. 19. ONE has not confirmed it.

Chinese container line CULines (China United Lines) was among 38 maritime firms listed by extortion group n0n Group on Oct. 12, 2026, which claimed to have stolen shipping data and demanded $2.4M-$14M in Bitcoin by Oct. 19. CULines has not confirmed the claim.

Container shipping line T.S. Lines was one of 38 maritime organizations listed by the new n0n Group extortion gang on Oct. 12, 2026, which claimed theft of EDI, manifest and terminal data and demanded $2.4M-$14M by Oct. 19. Unconfirmed; a shared CLT software system is suspected.

Chinese port-crane maker ZPMC was one of 38 maritime organizations listed by the new n0n Group extortion gang on Oct. 12, 2026, which claimed theft of EDI, manifest and terminal data and demanded $2.4M-$14M by Oct. 19. Unconfirmed; a shared CLT software system is suspected.

ConnectWise discovered unauthorized access involving Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) application credentials on October 14, 2026; the initial credential-exposure date and method were not disclosed. Attackers abused these and related Cloud Management identities to access customer Microsoft 365 tenants. Huntress documented Global Administrator elevation and planted application secrets in two investi

Japan's state trade-promotion agency JETRO detected unauthorized access to its website starting Oct. 14, 2026 and took the site offline; it disclosed the breach Oct. 19 and later confirmed 743 personal-information records were leaked. No attacker has been identified.

A private IT services firm in Bengaluru, India, complained that company data had been stolen and that it faced bitcoin extortion demands; Whitefield Police booked three of its employees, per a report in Oct 2026.

Cloud platform Zeabur said an attacker used leaked plaintext internal credentials on Oct. 14-15, 2026 to enter its shared cluster, some dedicated servers and platform database, taking 3.2M environment variables and data on 321,810 accounts. Zeabur will shut down by Dec. 31.

An outside group used a Meta employee's stolen credentials to access some of Meta's GitHub repositories, taking mostly product source code plus personal data of ~1,500 people, mostly U.S. employees. Meta rotated secrets and began notifying people Oct. 13, 2026.

Pattison Food Group, B.C. operator of Save-On-Foods and the More Rewards loyalty program, detected unusual activity on a server in mid-Oct. 2026 and confirmed members' names, contact details and birth dates were accessed. It took the server offline; no actor named.

An extortion gang claimed in Oct. 2026 to have copied data from Deloitte, alongside Confluent, KFC and MoneyGram. Deloitte said it is investigating potential unauthorized access linked to third-party vendor systems.

Everest ransomware group listed Rhode Island satellite communications firm KVH Industries on its leak site on Oct. 13, 2026, claiming about 41 GB of stolen data. As of Oct. 29 the data was unpublished and the company had made no public disclosure.

An unnamed extortion gang claimed in Oct. 2026 to have copied data from Dallas-based money transfer firm MoneyGram, alongside Confluent, Deloitte and KFC. MoneyGram said it is investigating potential unauthorized access linked to third-party vendor systems.

Dutch-Belgian grocer Ahold Delhaize took systems offline on Oct. 12, 2026 after a cyberattack, disrupting online orders and home deliveries for most brands in Europe and the US while stores stayed open. Services were being restored by Oct. 19-20; no evidence of data theft.

An extortion gang listed U.S. data-streaming software firm Confluent on its leak site around Oct. 12, 2026, claiming to have stolen corporate data and threatening to publish it; threat-intel trackers attribute the listing to The Gentlemen. Confluent has not commented.

Carrefour said 80 French supermarkets were hit when attackers manipulated internet-connected refrigeration controls overnight Oct. 11-12, 2026, apparently via outdated Danfoss firmware, heating fridges and spoiling food. ANSSI and prosecutors are investigating; no actor named.

Attackers remotely manipulated Danfoss refrigeration controls at French Intermarché and Netto stores (Les Mousquetaires) from Oct. 11, 2026, heating units and forcing defrosts in ~180 stores; food was discarded, with losses in the millions of euros. ANSSI and prosecutors probe.

French supermarket cooperative Coopérative U said attackers disrupted refrigeration controls in more than 100 of its stores from the night of Oct. 11, 2026, part of a nationwide attack on Danfoss systems; CEO Dominique Schelcher called it unprecedented. ANSSI is investigating.

French retailer E.Leclerc confirmed on Oct. 12, 2026 that several of its stores were hit by a nationwide attack on internet-connected Danfoss refrigeration controls that heated fridges and forced defrosts at French supermarkets. Paris prosecutors and ANSSI are investigating.

French supermarket chain Monoprix said ~5% of its ~490 stores were hit when attackers remotely manipulated connected Danfoss refrigeration controls from Oct. 11, 2026, heating fridges and spoiling food in a wider attack on retailers. Paris prosecutors and ANSSI are investigating.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: TFG London, UK owner of Hobbs, Whistles and Phase Eight, was hit by a cyberattack on Oct. 11, 2026 that took down some IT systems and websites and paused online orders. On Oct. 28 it told customers contact, delivery and order data were accessed; stores stayed open.

Microsoft studio The Coalition (Vancouver) said DDoS attacks on Gears of War: E-Day's online services on Oct. 11, 2026, its launch weekend, caused disconnects and login problems. The attack was brought under control within hours; no attacker was identified.

Over 200 GB of internal Cartoon Network production files for 30+ shows, including Adventure Time and Teen Titans, leaked online via X users around Oct. 10-11, 2026, days after Paramount acquired Warner Bros. Who leaked them and how is unknown; the companies did not comment.

San Diego glucose-monitor maker DexCom confirmed on Oct. 10, 2026 that voice phishing let an unauthorized party access data from internal documents. Redact claimed the attack; leaked data covers ~330,000 people. DexCom said operations were unaffected.

Icon Oncology Group, Australia's largest cancer care provider, confirmed on Oct. 12, 2026 unauthorised access to patient correspondence held on a supplier's system after a hacker known as '2019' offered 31,000+ documents for sale. Icon notified the AFP and regulators.

The Gentlemen ransomware gang listed fast-food chain KFC on its leak site around Oct. 10, 2026, claiming to have stolen data, in a batch that also named Confluent, Deloitte and MoneyGram. No samples were shared and KFC has not confirmed the claim.

org: Korean Federation of Community Credit Cooperatives
desc: South Korea's Korean Federation of Community Credit Cooperatives (Saemaul Geumgo) said an Oct. 10, 2026 hacking attack leaked personal data of about 400 mutual-aid customers. It blocked attacker IPs, fixed website flaws, notified regulators Oct. 13 and pledged compensation.

A cyberattack on Oct. 9, 2026 knocked most online services of the Town of Bernalillo, New Mexico offline, froze online bill pay and closed its MVD office. The town said no data had been compromised so far; the FBI and state cybersecurity office were contacted.

AI infrastructure provider Andromeda said attackers gained unauthorized access to some company and customer credentials starting around Oct. 9, 2026, part of an industry-wide attack. It disabled the accounts Oct. 13 and found no access to customer models or data.

A cyber breach starting Oct. 9, 2026 disrupted phones, internet and shared software for the City of North Platte and Lincoln County, Neb.; 911 stayed up. Gov. Pillen activated the National Guard cyber team; officials called the breach contained and found no data compromised.

An attacker tampered with an update of Jurojin Poker's player software to install Mesh remote-access spyware on users' PCs and watch high-stakes players' hole cards while playing them. Jurojin confirmed the attack in Oct. 2026, notified users and filed reports with authorities.

A cyber breach beginning Oct. 9, 2026 knocked out all Lincoln County, Nebraska phone lines, including the Sheriff's Office, and disrupted internet and shared software with the City of North Platte; county offices closed early. The governor activated the National Guard cyber team.

org: Primaire socialiste et démocrate (e-votez voting platform)
desc: The e-votez online voting platform for France's socialist and social-democratic left primary was flooded with bot-driven fake connections from opening on Oct. 9, 2026, slowing voting and blocking some voters. Organizers said ballots were intact and went to the courts.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: Ubuntu publisher Canonical (UK) said on Oct. 8, 2026 that a sustained DDoS attack on its web infrastructure made canonical.com, ubuntu.com, its blog, developer portal and Ubuntu Security and Livepatch APIs unavailable or degraded for more than four hours. No one claimed it.

Japanese railway JR East lost access to email-delivery systems hosted by cloud provider IDC Frontier after ransomware encrypted IDC Frontier servers on Oct. 8, 2026; JR East and card unit View Card said up to 6.09M records may have been accessed. No group claimed it.

Japanese railway JR Kyushu reported about 1.3M email records exposed after ransomware encrypted servers at cloud provider IDC Frontier, which hosted its email-delivery services shared with JR East, on Oct. 8, 2026. No group claimed the attack.

org: Mid Atlantic Gynecologic Oncology and Pelvic Surgery Associates
desc: Northern Virginia practice Mid Atlantic Gynecologic Oncology and Pelvic Surgery Associates was listed by the NetRunner ransomware group on Oct. 8, 2026, claiming ~164k records incl. SSNs and diagnoses. The practice has not confirmed; a law firm opened an investigation.

St Andrew's Hospital, a private hospital in Adelaide, confirmed on Oct. 8, 2026 that a subset of data was downloaded from its servers, exposing personal information of a group of individuals. It took systems offline as a precaution, notified those affected and the OAIC and ACSC.

SoftBank cloud unit IDC Frontier (Tokyo) said a ransomware attack on Oct. 7, 2026 knocked out IDCF Cloud East Japan Region 1, hitting 495 firms and local governments incl. Nissui Logistics and Ibaraki Prefecture sites; portal data of 48 customers was viewed. No group named.

N0n extortion group listed New Jersey managed IT provider Chibitek on its leak site on Oct. 7, 2026, claiming client financial records and network credentials, and published the data as 'not paid' on Oct. 11. Chibitek has not commented publicly.

An unauthorized user took over a Clio Area Schools (Mich.) staff email account on Oct. 7, 2026 and used it to send phishing emails to parents and other recipients. The district suspended the account and opened an investigation.

Japan's Ibaraki Prefecture lost its official and prefectural police websites on Oct. 7, 2026 after a ransomware attack on its hosting provider, SoftBank's IDC Frontier, which hit 495 customers. The prefecture opened a temporary site on Oct. 8; no group was identified.

industry: Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediat
desc: Ixa Systems, a video-surveillance and access-control firm in Crissier, Vaud, Switzerland, suffered a ransomware attack that apparently stole clients' camera locations, passwords and security plans, including for prisons and banks, Le Temps reported Oct. 7, 2026.

Japanese media group Nikkei Inc. disclosed in mid-Oct 2026 that hackers used stolen credentials on 7 Oct to access a cloud-based system-development environment, exposing about 1.83M records (150,000 with personal details). It was Nikkei's third breach disclosure in a month.

Nissui Logistics said on 8 Oct 2026 that a ransomware attack on its data-center provider IDC Frontier, a SoftBank unit, paralyzed its logistics system and halted inbound/outbound operations at 17 sites in Japan, affecting about 1,200 partners; it is checking for data exposure.

Jackson, Miss. web host U.S.NEXT confirmed a cyberattack that knocked out customer websites and email from about Oct. 7-9, 2026, including 69 Mississippi government sites such as Madison and Hinds counties. It is working with the FBI and DHS; no restoration estimate was given.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: Alternative rock band Radiohead releases 18 tracks of its OK Computer album sessions after hackers stole several archived mini discs from Thom Yorke, the band's lead singer and main songwriter.

The U.S. Customs and Border Protection says that a data breach exposed photos of the faces and license plates for more than 100,000 travelers. The breach is allegedly related to the one suffered by Perceptics earlier this year.

actor_country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: The official Twitter account of Bollywood's legend actor and producer Amitabh Bachchan is apparently hacked by Turkish hacking group calling itself Ayy?ld?z Tim.
Hopkins County School System is hit by a phishing attack.
Lake City is hit by a ransomware attack that knocks out its email and online payment systems.
Nova Scotia Health Authority notifies about 3,000 potential victims of a phishing attack occurred on May 8, 2019.

Researchers from Morphisec Labs observe a new, highly sophisticated variant of the ShellTea/PunchBuggy backdoor malware that attempted to infiltrate a number of machines within the network of a target in the hotel-entertainment industry.
The Emuparadise retro gaming site reportedly suffers a data breach, dating back April 2018. The breach exposed account information for approximately 1.1 million forum members.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: Cyber criminals steal 3.2 million Ripple coins (XRP), worth nearly $10 million, from the users of the GateHub cryptocurrency wallet service. The hack occurred on June 1st.
Auburn Food Bank in King County, Washington, falls victim to a ransomware attack (GlobeImposter 2.0).
Rapper Dave East may have fallen victim to a nude leak after a series of explicit photos purportedly of the rapper emerge online.
The European Union's embassy in Moscow was hacked and had information stolen from its network back in February 2017. The attack was discovered in April 2019.

Up to 200,000 students and staff of the Australian National University have personal data stolen in a "sophisticated" cyber attack. The attackers stole data stretching back 19 years. The breach occurred in late 2018 and was detected two weeks ago.
Ellwood City Medical Center officials investigate whether any patient records were compromised after a cyber attack.

industry: Administrative and Support and Waste Management and Remediat
desc: A malicious activity on the payment pages of the American Medical Collection Agency, leads to the compromise of millions of records, including 11.9 from Quest Diagnostic and 7.7 from LabCorp. The breach dated back to August 1, 2018 until March 30, 2019.

org: Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS) (APT 34 OilRig)
desc: Jason, a tool for hijacking Microsoft Exchange email accounts allegedly used by the Iran-linked OilRig hacker group is leaked online.
Eurofins Scientific is hit by a ransomware attack.

Broome County says an unauthorized individual may have had access to the personal information of county employees and individuals who receive the county?s care, after a phishing attack between November 2018 and January 2019.

org: Israeli companies, kibbutzim and private individuals
desc: Israel indicted ex-CISO Michael Bar of Ashkelon on Sept 10, 2026 for allegedly planting AI-built malware from 2019 until his August 2026 arrest in 26 companies, two kibbutzim and individuals, stealing passwords, correspondence and business data and recording via webcams.

Broome County says an unauthorized individual may have had access to the personal information of employees and individuals who receive the county's care. An employee email account was compromised between Nov. 20, 2018, and Jan. 2.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: Leicester City FC notifies people who used its online shop that their financial details have been stolen by hackers, including credit card numbers and CVVs. The hack occurred between 23 April and 4 May, 2019.
People Inc., a New York non-profit agency, reveals a data breach occurred on February 19, 2019 when two email accounts were compromised.

APNIC, the organization providing IP addressing services to the APAC reveals that earlier in May, the traffic going through a DNS run by the Taiwan Network Information Center (TWNIC) was rerouted to an entity in Brazil for about three and a half minutes.
Checkers and Rally's discloses a security breach which allowed attackers to steal payment card data from customers after infecting the POS systems in 103 locations from 20 states with malware.
The Lewes Board of Public Works announces to customers that their information may have been compromised as part of a hacking attempt.

Flipboard identifies unauthorized access to some databases containing certain users' account information, including account credentials. The unauthorized access occurred between June 2, 2018 and March 23, 2019 and April 21-22, 2019.
Iggy Azalea has deactivated her social media accounts, after her topless photos were leaked online.
Canva, a Sydney-based startup that's behind the eponymous graphic design service is hacked and data for roughly 139 million users are compromised.

industry: Real Estate and Rental and Leasing
desc: Hackers make off with hundreds, possibly thousands, of identity card scans after breaking into the computer system of rental housing agency NederWoon.
Perceptics, the maker of vehicle license plate readers used by the US government is hacked. Its internal files are leaked and offered for free on the dark web to download.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: The third-party mailbox used by Computacenter UK Ltd employees and contractors to deposit data for security clearance applications is hacked and used in phishing scams.
In name of #OpPulizia, Anonymous Italia release leaks of the Italian Union of State Police and four additional national organizations.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: Hackers access users' personal details in a cyber attack on Sunderland City Council's library database.
The US Air Force opens an investigation into a "malware" infection, which it is blaming on lawyers employed by the US Navy who are working on a war crimes case.
Coventry Local School District is forced to send students and some of its staff home after a Trickbot malware infection causes major issues to its IT infrastructure.
The Louisville Regional Airport Authority (LRAA) is hit by a ransomware attack.

Channel One TV, the channel that broadcasts the show "The Voice Kids" in Russia, announces to cancel the results of the vote after an investigation by Group-IB reveals a massive automated SMS spamming" in favor of one participant.

org: President Trump's U.S. Golf Association account
desc: Hackers access President Trump's U.S. Golf Association account and add four fake golf scores for games allegedly played at two courses.
Passwords and log-in details for hundreds of LibertyBus customers are obtained by attackers, who used a spoof website to divert those wanting to top up their pre-paid cards.
Cancer Treatment Centers of America sends notification letters to patients whose protected health information was in an employee email account compromised by a phishing attack.

The Oregon Construction Contractors Board says it has discovered a breach involving 8,013 accounts. Unauthorized individuals gained access to some contractors' usernames and passwords between Oct. 27 and Oct. 29, 2018, and was discovered on April 12, 2019

TeamViewer confirms today that it has been the victim of a cyber attack which was discovered during the autumn of 2016, but was never disclosed. This attack is thought to be of Chinese origins and utilized the Winnti backdoor.
OGUSERS, a forum where hackers and cybercriminals trade stolen Instagram and Twitter accounts is apparently hacked.
The Singapore Red Cross says its website has been hacked and the personal data of more than 4,000 potential blood donors compromised.
In a short announcement, Stack Overflow informs that it was the target of an attack that resulted in hackers accessing its production systems. The breach occurred on May 5.
Theater company The Shubert Organization discloses a data breach. An authorized party had accessed certain Shubert employees' email accounts, which contained customer information.

In name of #OpPharma, Anonymous Italia defaces and dumps data from the websites of four healthcare websites: the National Association of Hospital Primaries, ASSIST Italy, HS Hospital Services, and the Association of Surgeons and Odontologists in Savona.

org: Association of Surgeons and Odontologists in Savona
desc: In name of #OpPharma, Anonymous Italia defaces and dumps data from the websites of four healthcare websites: the National Association of Hospital Primaries, ASSIST Italy, HS Hospital Services, and the Association of Surgeons and Odontologists in Savona.
Boost Mobile is hit with a breach which affected an unknown number of customer accounts. The company experienced unauthorized online account on March 14, 2019.

Researchers from Bad Packets discover that hackers injected the Forbes' subscription website with a Magecart script which collects payment card data customers introduce on the checkout page and exfiltrates it to a server controlled by the attackers.

In name of #OpPharma, Anonymous Italia defaces and dumps data from the websites of four healthcare websites: the National Association of Hospital Primaries, ASSIST Italy, HS Hospital Services, and the Association of Surgeons and Odontologists in Savona.

In name of #OpPharma, Anonymous Italia defaces and dumps data from the websites of four healthcare websites: the National Association of Hospital Primaries, ASSIST Italy, HS Hospital Services, and the Association of Surgeons and Odontologists in Savona.
The Paterson Public Schools is hit by a massive breach: 23,103 account passwords and other computer access tokens are stolen.

Sanguine Security researcher Willem de Groot discovers that hackers compromised the script used by Best of the Web to display their trust seal on their customers' websites and to add two key logging scripts designed to sniff keystrokes from visitors.
Equitas Health notifies 569 members after discovering two employee email accounts had been compromised.
Israel's webcast of the Eurovision Song Contest semi-final is hacked with animated images of explosions. KAN, the national TV broadcaster in Israel, blames Hamas for the attack.
Oklahoma City Public Schools confirm they are addressing a recent ransomware attack, compromising the district's network.
Governor Ron DeSantis reveals that Russian hackers hit two Florida voter databases during the 2016 US presidential election.

Fast Retailing, the company behind multiple Japanese retail brands, announces that the UNIQLO Japan and GU Japan online stores have been hacked and third parties accessed 461,091 accounts following a credential stuffing attack between April 23 and May 10.
Oregon Health Authority provides early notification to Oregon State Hospital patients of a phishing incident occurred on May 6 and targeting an email account containing OSG data.

Fast Retailing, the company behind multiple Japanese retail brands, announces that the UNIQLO Japan and GU Japan online stores have been hacked and third parties accessed 461,091 accounts following a credential stuffing attack between April 23 and May 10.
Hackers breach the Cloud CMS managed CDN and modify one of the Alpaca Form scripts to inject malicious code in over 3,400 sites.
Hackers breach the analytics service Picreel and embed malicious code on over 1,200 websites.
FirstBank cancels debit cards because of what the bank described as a "possible external security" incident that affected the bank.

A data breach involving a medical collection agency affects more than 200,000 patients who had used the firm's online payment portal between September, 2018 and the beginning of March, 2019. The data is found on the dark web.
Episcopal Health Services warn of a data breach due to a suspicious activity in employee email accounts between August 28, 2018 and October 5, 2018.

Pacers Sports & Entertainment (PSE), the legal entity behind the Indiana Pacers and the Indiana Fever NBA and WNBA basketball teams, announces a security breach during which hackers gained access to sensitive user information via a phishing attack.

org: The Southeastern Council on Alcoholism and Drug Dependence, Inc. ("SCADD")
desc: The Southeastern Council on Alcoholism and Drug Dependence, Inc. ("SCADD") provides notice of a ransomware attack affecting 25,148 patients.

Two new leaks exposing Iranian cyber-espionage operations are published via Telegram, the Dark Web and the Internet. One claims to contain data from the MuddyWater group, while the second leak exposes a new group identified as the Rana Institute.

Amazon.com Inc. said it was hit by an "extensive" fraud, revealing that unidentified hackers were able to siphon funds from merchant accounts over six months last year.
Systems at a number of Baltimore's city government departments are taken offline by a ransomware attack caused by the RobbinHood malware.
Daviess County Public is hit by a ransomware attack.

Spectrum Health Lakeland notifies a breach of billing provider, OS Inc. Other victims include: Tahoe Forest Health District, Sparta Community Hospital, Sauk Prairie Healthcare, Idaho Department of Health and Welfare, Fort Healthcare, Midwest MC.

org: 30,000 Roman lawyers, including the Mayor of Rome Virginia Raggi
desc: Hackers from LulzSec Italia and Anonymous Italia leak online sensitive data of 30,000 Roman lawyers, including the Mayor of Rome Virginia Raggi.

org: American Baptist Homes of the Midwest
desc: American Baptist Homes of the Midwest notifies patients and residents of ransomware incident occurred on May 6, 2019.
Metro Presort was attacked by the Ryuk ransomware gang. At the time, the company was serving 21 healthcare entities which may have been affected by the attack.
Middletown Public Schools are hit by a ransomware attack.
The global information services firm Wolters Kluwer is crippled by a ransomware attack.

Wyzant, an online marketplace that connects parents and students reveals a data breach which has led to the compromise of user data including Facebook profile information. The breach occurred on April 27.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: Several Airbnb users complain that their accounts have been "hacked" with some finding holidays unknowingly booked in their name costing thousands of pounds.
Austrian construction company Porr detects a cyber attack on its communication infrastructure and its telephone lines and emails are disrupted.
Augustana College is the victim of a ransomware attack.

org: Telangana State Southern Power Distribution Company Ltd (TSSPDCL)
desc: The websites of Telangana State Southern Power Distribution Company Ltd (TSSPDCL) and its AP counterpart were hacked a couple of days ago, disrupting web services, including online payments.
Officials reveal that the Tertiary Education Subsidy (TES) applicants database, containing the private data of 1,130,899 applicants was accessed by unknown intruders on March 16.
Charles River Laboratories International, Inc. notifies clients of unauthorized access into portions of its information systems.

Citycomp GMBH is hacked. The attackers claim to have stolen 312,570 files (over 516GBb of information). Targets include Ericsson, Leica, Toshiba, UniCredit, British Telecom, Hugo Boss, NH Hotel Group, Oracle, Airbus, Porsche, and Volkswagen.

org: Grid operations in parts of the western United States
desc: A report posted by the Department of Energy indicates that a cyber event interrupted grid operations in parts of the western United States on March 5.
Michael Bubles Instagram account is apparently hacked, when some strange images are shown for about half an hour.
Users of a McDonald's app in Canada are having their accounts hijacked by hackers who are using the accounts to order food for themselves, racking up bills in excess of CAD $2,000.
Puma Australia is the latest victim of a Magecart attack.

Hackers steal $1.75 million from the Saint Ambrose Catholic Parish following a successful BEC attack which was discovered on April 17 after payments related to the church's Vision 2020 project were not received by a contractor.
A detailed list or 137,000 SkyMed members accounts is found, on March 27th, into an unsecured Elasticsearch database. The leak also shows evidence of ransomware inside the network.
Cleveland Hopkins International Airport reveals to have been hit by a ransomware attack.
A Ryuk cyber attack takes down the data infrastructure of Johnson Newspaper Corp.
A ransomware attack takes down servers at Sugar-Salem School District 322.

The University of Alaska notifies potentially affected students and individuals after an investigation into a data privacy incident involving potential unauthorized access to certain UA email accounts, occurred in February 2018.
The Woodruff Arts Center says it is investigating a security breach after a massive network outage, allegedly caused by ransomware.

A new phishing scam targeting Chase bank customers is discovered that not only asks for personal information, but also requests that the victim uploads a selfie of himself holding his ID or driver license.

An unauthorized person gain access to a Docker Hub database that exposed sensitive information for approximately 190,000 users. This information included some usernames and hashed passwords, as well as tokens for GitHub and Bitbucket repositories.

org: Hong Kong branch of Amnesty International
desc: The Hong Kong branch of human rights group Amnesty International reveal it was targeted by state-sponsored hackers in a cyberattack "consistent with those carried out by hostile groups linked to the Chinese government".
Researchers from Cybereason discover a spear phishing campaign targeting a financial institution, and installing a sophisticated backdoor called ServHelper to take over the network.

org: archivi-sias.it (National Archives from the Italian Ministry of Cultural Heritage and Activities)
desc: Hackers from LulzSec Italia dump more than 5,000 credentials from the National Archives of the Italian Ministry of Cultural Heritage and Activities.

Delta Dental discloses a security incident affecting an unspecified number of their insured members and dependents. An employee had fallen prey to a phishing attack between December 21 and December 28 last year.
Doctors' Management Services (DMS) reveals to have been struck with GandCrab ransomware on Christmas Eve last year, possibly exposing the PII of its clients' patients.
Scott County Schools announce that the district was the victim of a $3.7 million online scam, when an undisclosed vendor told the district it never was paid for an invoice.

actor: FSB 18th Center for Information Security (Berserk Bear)
desc: Security researchers at Yoroi-Cybaze ZLab uncover a new campaign carried out by the Russian state-actor dubbed Gamaredon targeting Military personnel in Ukraine.
A ransomware infection takes down the operations of A2 Hosting, a US-based web hosting provider.
Aebi Schmidt, a Swiss manufacturing giant with operations in the U.S., is hit by a ransomware attack.
Eight e-scooters from Lime, a Brisbane-based manufacturer, have their audio files swapped during a test in the streets of Brisbane.

Bodybuilding.com notifies its customers of a security breach detected during February 2019 which was the direct result of a phishing email received back in July 2018. Potentially 18M users are impacted.
Potter County is hit by ransomware.
The online shop for the Atlanta Hawks professional NBA basketball team has malicious code injected into (Magecart Infection).

EmCare Inc. discloses that an unauthorized party obtained access to a number of employees' email accounts that contained the personal information of as many as 60,000 individuals, 31,000 of which are patients.
Partners for Quality notifies 3,673 clients after some employees' email accounts are compromised.

org: Ministry of Intelligence and Security (MOIS) (APT 34 OilRig)
desc: A collective dubbed Lab Dookhtegan reveal details about the inner workings of the cyber-espionage group known as OilRig, APT34, and HelixKitten, linked to the Iranian government. The source code of their tools is leaked on Telegram.
The City of Augusta municipal services are hit by a ransomware attack.
The Weather Channel is hit by a ransomware attack.
Some Chipotle customers claim their accounts have been hacked and report fraudulent orders charged to their credit cards. The company states credential stuffing is to blame.
The Israel offices of US cyber-security firm Verint are hit by ransomware.
Centrelake Medical Group notifies almost 198,000 patients after a virus investigation reveals earlier intrusion and suspicious activity.

Researchers from FireEye reveal that multiple Ukrainian military departments were targeted by a spear phishing campaign which attempted to drop a RATVERMIN backdoor as part of a second-stage payload delivered with the help of a Powershell script.

The same group that hacked the FBINAA claims to have published what appears to be the information of tens of thousands of American Advertising Federation (AAF) members, saying it's an FBI watchlist. However there are many doubts.
The city of Stratford is hit by a ransomware attack.
Indian IT outsourcing and consulting giant Wipro Ltd. investigates reports that its own IT systems have been hacked and are being used to launch attacks against some of the company's customers.
The City of Stuart is hit by a Ryuk ransomware attack.
Garfield County reveals it was the victim of a ransomware attack, crippling the work of city personnel for weeks before they were able to pay to get access to their own data.
Imperial County is hit by a ransomware attack.

org: Blue Cross of Idaho Health Service
desc: Blue Cross of Idaho Health Service notifies that, on March 21, 2019, an unauthorized user accessed Blue Cross of Idaho's online provider portal and was able to access provider remittance documents, which contained PHI.
Dakota County notifies 1000 individuals of an incident occurred on February 13, 2019, when an email account belonging to one of its employees was accessed without authorization.

A hacker group breaches three sites associated with the FBI National Academy Associates and uploads their contents to the web, including dozens of files containing the personal information of thousands of federal agents and law enforcement officers.
A 0-day vulnerability in the Yuzo WordPress plugin causes the Flashpoint website to briefly redirect the users to an external website with a pop-up leading to malware.
Kyushu Railway Co. reveals that personal and credit information on up to 8,000 customers were stolen from the goods store website for its "Seven Stars in Kyushu" luxury cruise train.
Questcare Medical Services announces to have discovered a security incident. On February 13, an unauthorized third party obtained access to an employee's email account.
The city of Greenville is hit by the RobbinHood ransomware. A new strain that claims to protect the victim's privacy.
Father Bill's and MainSpring, a nonprofit homeless shelter, announces that it had been attacked by ransomware in April.
Riverplace Counseling Center notifies 11,639 patients after a security incident due to a ransomware occurred on January 20, 2019.
Uniden's website for commercial security products is hacked to host a Word document that delivers what appears to be a garden variety of the Emotet trojan, also known as Geodo and Heodo.
The website of the free multimedia editor VSDC is breached again to distribute a banking trojan and an info stealer (Win32.Bolik.2 and KPOT stealer).
An orchestrated disinformation campaign hits the Lithuanian Ministry of Defense.
Matrix.org is the victim of a cyberattack which forces the organization to overhaul its entire production infrastructure and inform users of a widespread credentials leak.
An undisclosed number of patients at the Rehabilitation Hospital of Northwest Ohio have their personal data compromised after "unauthorized access" to employee email accounts in October.
Researchers from SI-LAB reveal the details of a cyber attack carried out via a variant of the EMOTET banking trojan, targeting users in Chile.
The largest transport company in the Republic of Bashkortostan Bashauto (Bashavtotrans) is hacked.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
desc: King's College London warns staff and students that some accounts have been "compromised" due to an apparent brute-force attack on password systems.

Minnesota Department of Human Services announced to have suffered a data breach that may have exposed the personal information of about 11,000 people after an employee's email is compromised on March 26, 2019.
Tenx Systems reveals to have been hit by a ransomware attack discovered on April 9.

org: Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation (Petrobangla)
desc: The official website of the Bangladesh Oil, Gas and Mineral Corporation (Petrobangla) is defaced twice in the space of few hours.
Baystate Medical Center warns that personal information belonging to about 12,000 patients was compromised following an email phishing attack occurred between Feb. 7 and March 7.
Weslaco Regional Rehabilitation Hospital notifies patients their information may have been compromised, after some employees' email accounts were compromised in October 2018.
RS Medical discloses a phishing attack occurred February 11/12 2019.
The election results service in Finland is the target of a DDoS attack.
Hardin Memorial Hospital experiences some type of attack or interruption over the weekend that might be a hacking incident. The nature is unclear.

Japanese eyeglass lens maker Hoya Corp. reports it was hit by a cyberattack at its key production base in Thailand in late February. Attackers started to mine cryptocurrency and led to a partial shutdown of its factory lines for three days.
Users of the blockchain platform Zilliqa are the targets of a phishing attack carried out by a fraudulent entity calling itself Zollo.

AeroGrow says in a letter to customers that its website had credit card scraping malware for more than four months. Anyone who bought something through its website between October 29, 2018 and March 4, 2019 could have been affected.
Clearway Pain Solutions Institute notifies 35,000 patients after discovering on February 20 that their EMR system had been accessed without authorization.
Health Recovery Services notifies 20,485 patients after discovering that an unauthorized IP address had accessed their network between November 2018 and February 5 2019.

Klaussner Furniture notifies more than 9,000 employees and their dependents of a data security incident when an unauthorized third party gained access to two computers on its network in February 2019.
Metrocare Services notifies 5,290 clients of a breach after an unauthorized third party gained access into some employees' email accounts beginning on January 2019.

actor: People's Liberation Army Strategic Support Force (PLA Unit 61398)
desc: Bayer reveals to have contained a cyber attack carried out by the Wicked Panda Group via the WINNTI malware.
The Sylvan Union School District is hit by an apparent ransomware attack whose remediation costs exceed $1 million.

org: Training School of the First Scout Ranger Regiment
desc: Emerging reports claim that the website of the training school of the First Scout Ranger Regiment, one of the Philippine Army's (PA) elite units, was hacked last year.
Almost half a million dollars is diverted out of the city of Tallahassee's employee payroll after a suspected foreign cyber-attack of its human resources management application.
Arizona Beverages, one of the largest beverage suppliers in the U.S., is hit by a ransomware attack.
Genesee County is hit with a ransomware attack and the county has been working non-stop to get their systems back online.

Georgia Tech announces that a vulnerability in a web application allowed an attacker to gain access to the personal information of up to 1.3 million students, college applications, staff, and faculty members. The breach was discovered on March 21.

Belgian officials said that hackers breached the network of its interior ministry in a security incident that took place in April 2019. The investigation found that the threat actor's motive was likely espionage.

Hackers used spyware, developed by Israeli technology firm NSO Group, that exploited a vulnerability in the messaging app WhatsApp to inject spyware onto the phones of opposition politicians and prominent religious leaders in Togo. The hack coincided with pro-reform protests in the country. Among the victims is Elliott Ohin who has served in several cabinet roles.

The online servers of the newly launched ATLAS game suffer some "technical difficulties" after players hack a STEAM admin account and spam fellow players for hours with "Subscribe to PewDiePie" messages.
Tampa Bay Credit Union members have their debit card information spoofed after threat actors generate false cards using the financial institution's bin numbers.
Officials based at the City of Del Rio, in Texas, are forced to abandon electronic services and switch to pen and paper after a ransomware attack effectively closed down City Hall servers.

Flashpoint analysts believe that the Lazarus Group is behind the recent intrusion suffered by Chilean interbank network Redbanc via carried out via the PowerRatankba malware.

Cryptopia currency exchange pulls its website and services offline, citing a "security breach" resulting in "significant losses." Apparently the equivalent of $1.2 million is transferred to an unknown address.
Faben Obstetrics and Gynecology notifies more than 6,000 patients after a GandCrab ransomware attack occurred in November 2018.

country: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

The Shift News suffers a DDoS attack, following the publication of a series of investigative stories on a hospitals deal.

org: Italian organization operating in the Oil&Gas sector

The Indian subsidiary of Tecnimont SpA falls prey to a fraud wherein $18.6 million (INR 130 crore) were being stolen by a group of Chinese hackers pretending to be trading an acquisition in China.
Another victim of Magecart. Discountmugs.com reveals that anyone who used a credit between August 5, 2018, and November 16, 2018 may have had their information compromised.
Sacred Heart Rehabilitation Center notifies patients of a phishing incident occurred in early April.
Another victim of the Click2Gov breach. Officials disclose that an unauthorized party stole credit card information between Aug. 1, 2018 and Jan. 9, 2019.

The Caddo Parish School System is scammed out of nearly $1 million in tax payer money after a phishing attack.

Coinbase detects a "deep chain reorganization" of the Ethereum Classic (ETC) blockchain. The equivalent of $1.1M is double spent, but the attacker reportedly returns $100,000 to cryptocurrency exchange Gate.io.
OXO International discloses a data breach that spans numerous periods over two years. Customer and payment information may have been exposed. The attack was most likely a MageCart attack.
Conservative Senator Linda Frum's Twitter account is hacked. The attackers share personal information including her drivers license and post racial tweets.
A hacker gains unauthorized access to the Queensland EWN, or Early Warning Network, and used it to send a spam alert via SMS, landline, and email to the company's subscribers.
The Resort Municipality of Whistler (RMOW) is reporting that its municipal website, whistler.ca, has been breached.
Chaplaincy Health Care offers free identity protection and credit monitoring to more than 1,000 people after an employee's email login credentials are compromised through an apparent phishing scheme.

In what is immediately called "Hacker-Angriff" (Hacker Attack), someone publishes the personal details of hundreds of German politicians, artists and local YouTube celebrities. Few days later a 20-year-old German confesses to be the author of the attack.
At least three employees of Wichita State University do not receive their paychecks after they fall victim of an e-mail phishing scheme.
The website of the tram operator Luas is taken down after a cyber attack. The author threatens to dump the records of about 3,000 if the ransom of 1 BTC ($3,843 worth) is not paid.
BlankMediaGames (BMG) admits that a hacker has stolen the personal details of 7.6 million users of browser-based game the "Town of Salem".

Data thieves steal the personal information of nearly 5 million people from an unconfirmed number of Chinese online ticket reservation platforms, according to Beijing police, who arrested a suspect in the case.

This cyber breach allegedly arose when a RMS employee clicked on a hyperlink in a phishing email that falsely appeared to originate from a RMS business partner.  The RMS employee provided her email credentials to the malicious website opened by the hyperlink.

Hackers launch an attack on the website of showman Volodymyr Zelenskiy following the announcement of his candidacy for president on New Year's Eve.
Choice Rehabilitation notifies patients after hack of corporate email account. The suspicious activity occurred from July 1, 2018 through September 30, 2018.

New York Oncology Hematology notifies nearly 130,000 patients and employees that it was the victim of a phishing attack occurred between April 20 and April 27.
OSIsoft LLC discloses a security breach which affected its employees, consultants, interns, and contractors. The credential theft involves 29 computers and 135 accounts.
Hackers compromise Daniel's Hosting, one of the largest Dark Web hosting provider, and deleted 6,500+ sites.
Some 2,000 clients of Albany-based nonprofit Family Tree Relief Nursery are notified of a ransomware attack occurred between June and August.

An intruder accesses the email accounts of two HealthEquity members, exposing protected and personal information of 20,906 subscribers. The breach dates back to September and October, and was discovered on October 5th.

German security officials detected a cyberattack, believed to be by the Russian group Snake, on the email accounts of German celebrities, lawmakers, military officials, and staff of several German embassies. As a result of the hack, the personal details of the victims were leaked online by the hackers. One of the victimis is German Chancellor Angela Merkel.

German security officials detected a cyberattack, believed to be by the Russian group Snake, on the email accounts of German celebrities, lawmakers, military officials, and staff of several German embassies. As a result of the hack, the personal details of the victims were leaked online by the hackers. One of the victimis is TV presenter Christian Ehring.
The Democratic National Committee (DNC) claims that Russian hackers tried to break into its servers in November 2018, shortly after the conclusion of the US midterm elections.

German security officials detected a cyberattack, believed to be by the Russian group Snake, on the email accounts of German celebrities, lawmakers, military officials, and staff of several German embassies. As a result of the hack, the personal details of the victims were leaked online by the hackers. One of the victimis is German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier.
A Magecart credit card skimming attack is discovered on the online store for the Infowars web site.
Unknown hackers gain access to thousands of Italian certified email accounts, including those of magistrates and security officials.

An unknown actor with a connection to Iran hijacked DNS records to target the traffic of governments and telecommunications organizations around the world. One of the victims is Middle East Airlines, a Lebanese airline.
Midlands Regional Hospital in Tullamore is hit by a ransomware attack.
Google's official G Suite Twitter account, which has more than 800,000 followers, is the latest victim of an increasingly widespread Bitcoin scam.
Target's Twitter account is hacked and its feed used to trick unsuspecting consumers into giving away cryptocurrency.

Health First, Inc. notifies 42,000 patients after a phishing incident.
Midlands State University is forced to postpone its Student Representative Council Elections after hackers breach the security system.
Cylance uncover a sophisticated state-sponsored campaign, tracked as Operation Shaheen, against the Pakistan Air Force, carried out by a nation-state actor tracked as the White Company.
May Eye Care notifies 30,000 patients after ransomware incident.
A malware received via phishing emails take down the systems of Chesapeake Public Schools.

Florida's Department of Health issues a notice of data breach detailing the compromise of an employee's Microsoft Outlook 365 account. Southwest Washington Regional Surgery Center notifies 2,393 patients after phishing attack exposed their PHI.
Bankers Life notifies more than 566,000 individuals after the hack of some employees' email results in a breach of PHI. The breach occurred between May 30 and September 13, 2018.

Megacable notifies its users of a cyber attack.

Several of Cambodia's biggest internet service providers (EZECOM, SINET, Telcotech, and Digi) are hit by large-scale DDoS attacks.

ASI Computer Systems notifies some of their customers after discovering that usernames and passwords on a support web site had been hacked prior to December 2016.
Five Guys notifies employees of data breach after an employee falls victim for a phishing attack.
Guests of two Tasmania's luxury hotels are notified that their personal data may have been accessed by an unauthorised third party.

Attackers gain access to some customer's information in HSBC, such as account numbers, balances, addresses, transaction history, etc.. The attack hits about 1% of U.S. accounts and occurred between October 4, 2018 and October 14, 2018.

desc: Educational electronics outlet Kitronik is the latest victim of the Magecart gang. The hack occurred between August and September.
Guests of two Tasmania's luxury hotels are notified that their personal data may have been accessed by an unauthorised third party.
AnonPlus hacks the website of the Italian Society of Authors and Publishers (SIAE) and leak 4Gb of data.
Hackers access confidential documents about nuclear plants and prisons in a cyberattack on the French Ingerop and leak 65Gb of data. The attack occurred back in June.

Australian defence shipbuilder Austal is the victim of a data breach and an extortion attempt. The attackers gain access to ship designs and to some staff email addresses and mobile phone numbers. Fingers point to Iran.
Episcopal Health Services notifies patients after employee email accounts are hacked.

Colbi Trent Defiore, an employee at a Virginia tech company, has been sent to prison for stealing PII from Healthcare.gov customers. Defiore improperly accessed the Healthcare.gov database several times in November 2018 and used the stolen information to commit fraud.
Canadian St. Francis Xavier University shuts down the entire network following a cryptojacking attack which attempted to use its systems' computing power to mine for Bitcoin.
Tallahassee Memorial Hospital reports the information of job applicants who applied to the facility may be at risk after a breach at Jobscience, a recruiting firm it uses.
NorthBay Healthcare Corporation suffers a data breach affecting the information of everyone who applied for a position within the organization between December 2012 and May 2018.

The hotel chain Radisson Hotel Group suffered a security breach that exposed personal information of the members of its loyalty scheme. The incident happened on September 11, but was identified only on October first.
FIFA acknowledges that its computer systems were hacked earlier in March, for the second time, and officials from European soccer's governing body fear they also might have suffered a data breach.
The hacktivist group Anonymous takes down 70 Gabon government websites as part of its "anti-dictatorships" campaign.
MapleChange, a Canadian crypto exchange, suffers a hack and looses all the funds (913 BTC, $6M worth), despite many accuse the exchange of attempting to stage an exit scam.
Hackers breach computer security at the Tomorrowland festival organizers, and steal the data of 64,000 people who signed up for tickets for the 2004 edition.

Karachi-based Bank Islami acknowledges of suffering a security breach of its payment cards system but denies reports of having lost an alleged $6 million in what local press have called the biggest cyber-attack in the country's history.
